archetypes.name: ci-timing
archetypes.rationale: Timing parser and retry dedup drive shard assignment correctness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pytest CI timing parser and aggregation logic. Focus on combined GitHub log formats, shard count extraction, duration-section attempt splitting, and latest-attempt dedup before baseline medians and verification totals. Check that malformed or missing timing data fails closed where required. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rebalance-safety
archetypes.rationale: The script mutates git artifacts and opens PRs, so ordering and rollback matter.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the rebalance.py orchestration for pre-write gates, artifact cleanliness, no-op handling, write ordering, rollback, and branch/commit/PR sequencing. Verify --kind all cannot leave partial Makefile or assignment changes and that Python verification dispatches before collection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pytest-sharding
archetypes.rationale: Runtime assignment-map safety must preserve full test coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review pytest_sharding.py and conftest.py for assignment-map loading and collection selection. Focus on rejecting malformed maps and JSON booleans, falling back on shard-count mismatch, and keeping unassigned nodeids on the existing round-robin path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
